أحتش (form VIII)
# أَحْتَشِ (ʔaḥtaši) /ʔaħ.ta.ʃi/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# أُحْتَشَ (ʔuḥtaša) /ʔuħ.ta.ʃa/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
